The destruction, degradation and fragmentation of habitat are the three predominant categories of habitat loss [17].

The habitat destruction is the massive destruction of the natural habitat of the species that it becomes incapable of upholding the native ecosystems and the species. This ultimately results in species extinction i.e., biodiversity loss.
